name: Buyer Protection Instruction Cancellation Request Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope|The BuyerProtectionInstructionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice message is sent by an account servicer to an account owner or its designated agent to report the status of a previously received BuyerProtectionInstructionCancellationRequest message sent by the account owner. This will include the acknowledgement/rejection of a request to cancel an outstanding instruction. ||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.name: Buyer Protection Instruction Identification
BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.definition: Identification of the related buyer protection instruction document for which the cancellation is requested.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.

InstructionCancellationRequestStatus.name: Instruction Cancellation Request Status
InstructionCancellationRequestStatus.definition: Provides information about the processing status of the instruction cancellation request.

RelatedSettlementInstruction.name: Related Settlement Instruction
RelatedSettlementInstruction.definition: Details of the buyer protected settlement instruction.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Selected safekeeping accounts list to which the corporate action event applies.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
